title: Where the screen knob sits
ask: Where on the climate unit does the new screen knob go: top left of the face, top right, below the centre knob, or on the left plate?
why: You moved the Display Unit's page button to the climate unit as a knob with a push (chat, 2026-10-14). Turning it changes the cluster's pages. A click, then a turn, sets the screen's brightness. The knob is wired on a short flying lead, so the boards are the same wherever it goes. What changes with your answer is the faceplate's hole, the lead's length and the two mock-ups. The face today, left to right: window switch, seat knob, two keys, the centre knob under the small screen, two keys, seat knob, window switch. The top corners beside the screen are empty.
options:
(a) Top left corner of the face, beside the screen and above the driver's seat knob. Nearest your hand and the cluster. The face keeps its size. Costs nothing.
(b) Top right corner, the same on the passenger side. The passenger can reach it, but it is further from you. The face keeps its size. Costs nothing.
(c) Below the centre knob, in the middle of the stack. Either seat can reach it. The face grows about 10 mm taller, so the climate unit's housing grows too. Costs nothing now.
(d) On the left plate, by the mirror stick, left of the wheel. It sits with the driver's other controls, off the climate face. The plate's board gets the header instead and the plate grows. Costs nothing now.
recommend: (a), unless the passenger should reach it - then (c)
stops: The faceplate's hole, the knob's lead length and the two mock-ups (Y51); no board waits on it
